9926-the-two-guardians-or-home-in-this-w.title: The Two Guardians Or Home In This World
9926-the-two-guardians-or-home-in-this-w.creator: Charlotte Mary Yonge
9926-the-two-guardians-or-home-in-this-w.description: A book by Charlotte Mary Yonge. The design of the "Castle Builders" is to show the instability and dissatisfaction of mind occasioned by the want of a practical, obedient course of daily life; with an especial view to the consequences of not seeking strength and assistance in the appointed means of grace.

arxiv-2102-00421.title: Larger Corner-Free Sets from Better NOF Exactly- N N Protocols
arxiv-2102-00421.creator: Adi Shraibman
arxiv-2102-00421.description: Abstract A subset of the integer planar grid [ N ] × [ N ] [N]\times[N] is called corner-free if it contains no triple of the form ( x , y ) , ( x + δ , y ) , ( x , y + δ ) (x,y),(x+\delta,y),(x,y+\delta) .

arxiv-2106-12215.title: Communication in Complex Networks
arxiv-2106-12215.creator: Omar De la Cruz Cabrera, Jiafeng Jin, Silvia Noschese, Lothar Reichel
arxiv-2106-12215.description: Abstract One of the properties of interest in the analysis of networks is global communicability , i.e., how easy or difficult it is, generally, to reach nodes from other nodes by following edges. Different global communicability measures provide quantitative assessments of this property, emphasizing different aspects of the problem.

arxiv-2310-14939.title: Expressive Power and Complexity Results for SIGNAL, an Industry-scale Process Query Language
arxiv-2310-14939.creator: Timotheus Kampik, Cem Okulmus
arxiv-2310-14939.description: Abstract With the increased adoption of process mining, there is also a need for practical solutions that work at industry scales. In this context, process querying methods (PQMs) have emerged as an important tool for drawing inferences from event logs. Here, it can be expected that industry approaches differ from academic ones, due to practical engineering and business considerations.

arxiv-2501-16977.title: An Automata-theoretic Basis for Specification and Type Checking of Multiparty Protocols
arxiv-2501-16977.creator: Felix Stutz, Emanuele D’Osualdo
arxiv-2501-16977.description: Abstract We propose the Automata-based Multiparty Protocols framework (AMP) for top-down protocol development. The framework features a new very general formalism for global protocol specifications called Protocol State Machines (PSMs), Communicating State Machines (CSMs) as specifications for local participants, and a type system to check a π \pi - calculus with session interleaving and delegation against the CSM specification.

arxiv-2504-05961.title: Replicator-mutator dynamics for public goods games with institutional incentives
arxiv-2504-05961.creator: N. Balabanova, M. H. Duong, T. A. Han
arxiv-2504-05961.description: Abstract Understanding the emergence and stability of cooperation in public goods games is important due to its applications in fields such as biology, economics, and social science. However, a gap remains in comprehending how mutations, both additive and multiplicative, as well as institutional incentives, influence these dynamics.

arxiv-2508-21628.title: Personality Matters: User Traits Predict LLM Preferences in Multi-Turn Collaborative Tasks
arxiv-2508-21628.creator: Sarfaroz Yunusov, Kaige Chen, Kazi Nishat Anwar and Ali Emami
arxiv-2508-21628.description: Abstract As Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly integrate into everyday workflows, where users shape outcomes through multi-turn collaboration, a critical question emerges: do users with different personality traits systematically prefer certain LLMs over others? We conduc-ted a study with 32 participants evenly distributed across four Keirsey personality types, evaluating their interactions with GPT-4 and Claude 3.

arxiv-2509-03456.title: Off-Policy Learning in Large Action Spaces: Optimization Matters More Than Estimation Conference: Recsys ’25: CONSEQUENCES Workshop; September, 2025; Prague CCS: Information systems Retrieval models and ranking
arxiv-2509-03456.creator: Imad Aouali, Otmane Sakhi
arxiv-2509-03456.description: Abstract . Off-policy evaluation (OPE) and off-policy learning (OPL) are foundational for decision-making in offline contextual bandits. Recent advances in OPL primarily optimize OPE estimators with improved statistical properties, assuming that better estimators inherently yield superior policies. Although theoretically justified, we argue this estimator-centric approach neglects a critical practical obstacle: challenging optimization landscapes.

arxiv-2510-12386.title: Hey Dashboard!: Supporting Voice, Text, and Pointing Modalities in Dashboard Onboarding
arxiv-2510-12386.creator: Vaishali Dhanoa, Gabriela Molina León, Eve Hoggan, Eduard Gröller, Marc Streit, Niklas Elmqvist
arxiv-2510-12386.description: Abstract Visualization dashboards are regularly used for data exploration and analysis, but their complex interactions and interlinked views often require time-consuming onboarding sessions from dashboard authors. Preparing these onboarding materials is labor-intensive and requires manual updates when dashboards change. Recent advances in multimodal interaction powered by large language models (LLMs) provide ways to support self-guided onboarding.

arxiv-2601-07129.title: Minimum and extremal process for a branching random walk outside the boundary case
arxiv-2601-07129.creator: Xinxin Chen, Haojie Hou
arxiv-2601-07129.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Xinxin Chen, Haojie Hou. This work extends the studies on the minimum and extremal process of a supercritical branching random walk outside the boundary case which cannot be reduced to the boundary case. We study here the situation where the log-generating function explodes at 1 1 and the random walk associated to the spine possesses a stretched exponential tail with exponent b ∈ ( 0 , 1 2 ) b\in(0,\frac{1}{2}) .

pmc-10648600.title: Isolation and Identification of Chemical Compounds from Agaricus blazei Murrill and Their In Vitro Antifungal Activities
pmc-10648600.creator: Ruirui Yu, Xiaojian Li, Peng Yi, Ping Wen, Shuhong Wang, Chenghui Liao, Xun Song, Haiqiang Wu, Zhendan He, Chenyang Li, Armando Zarrelli
pmc-10648600.description: This study explores the antifungal properties of Agaricus blazei Murrill, a valuable medicinal and edible fungus. Six compounds (1–6) were first isolated from A. blazei using various isolation techniques and identified using spectroscopic methods. These compounds include linoleic acid, 1,1′-oxybis(2,4-di-tert-butylbenzene), glycerol monolinoleate, volemolide (17R)-17-methylincisterol, (24s)-ergosta-7-en-3-ol, and dibutyl phthalate.

pmc-10772893.title: What can historical literature on von Willebrand disease teach us?
pmc-10772893.creator: Jecko Thachil, Riitta Lassila
pmc-10772893.description: Dr Erik von Willebrand first described a family with bleeding symptoms in a Finnish publication in 1926. A closer look at this landmark publication sheds light on some pathophysiological aspects of von Willebrand disease that may be applicable even in the current era.

pmc-11482007.title: Partial Recovery of Telomere Length After Long-term Virologic Suppression in Persons With HIV-1
pmc-11482007.creator: Julen Cadiñanos, Javier Rodríguez-Centeno, Rocío Montejano, Andrés Esteban-Cantos, Beatriz Mena-Garay, María Jiménez-González, Gabriel Saiz-Medrano, Rosa de Miguel, Fernando Rodríguez-Artalejo, José I Bernardino, Cristina Marcelo-Calvo, Lucía Gutierrez-García, Patricia Martínez-Martín, Alejandro Díe
pmc-11482007.description: BackgroundPeople with HIV-1 (PWH) age differently than the general population. Blood telomere length (BTL) attrition is a surrogate biomarker of immunosenescence and aging in PWH. BTL is reduced immediately after HIV-1 infection and recovers in PWH with long-term virologic suppression, but the extent of this recovery is unknown.

pmc-12373913.title: Ink based graphene integration into commercial contact lenses
pmc-12373913.creator: Muhammed Shebeeb C, Sanjana Chandran, Muhammed Hisham, Liya Jacob, Shanavas Shajahan, Yarjan Abdul Samad, Abdulrahim Sajini, Haider Butt
pmc-12373913.description: Introducing multiple functionalities to contact lenses (CLs) are achieved by additives such as nanomaterials, pigments, and dyes. CLs with graphene have been used in electromagnetic interference (EMI) shielding, drug delivery and sensing. Generally, CVD graphene or graphene nanocomposites are used during the manufacturing stage of CLs.

pmc-12623461.title: Demographic Patterns and Clinical Presentations of Demodicosis in a Longitudinal Study From Khuzestan Province, Southwest Iran
pmc-12623461.creator: Sharif Maraghi, Mehdi Tavalla, Abdollah Rafiei, Mohammad Javad Boozhmehrani, Akbar Hoseinnejad
pmc-12623461.description: Background and AimsDemodicosis is a significant dermatological condition caused by Demodex mites, with a wide range of clinical manifestations. Despite its prevalence, population‐based studies on the epidemiology, co‐infections, and atypical presentations of demodicosis remain limited globally. This study aimed to investigate the demographic patterns, clinical characteristics, and associated co‐infections of demodicosis over a 22‐year period in southwest Iran.

pmc-13170739.title: Total Hip Replacement with Use of the French Paradox Cementing Technique for a Shortened Charnley-Kerboull Stem via a Bikini Approach
pmc-13170739.creator: Pierre Laboudie, Luc Kerboull, Moussa Hamadouche
pmc-13170739.description: Background:The “French Paradox” technique, one of the various femoral cementing techniques in total hip replacement, was developed by Marcel Kerboull at Cochin Hospital, Paris, in the 1960s. Its fundamental principles include removal of the cancellous bone, use of a highly polished and collared canal-filling stem, and a straightforward cementation technique.

pmc-13184170.title: Clinical Outcomes of Selenium Supplementation in Hashimoto's Thyroiditis Without Selenium Deficiency: A Large‐Scale Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-13184170.creator: Eman A. Toraih, Sarah Yaghi, Claire Ardis, Lori Tran, Ahmed Abdelmaksoud, Rami M. Elshazli, Mohammad H. Hussein, Hinali Patel, Ekramy M. Elmorsy, Jessan A. Jishu, Hani Aiash, Manal S. Fawzy
pmc-13184170.description: IntroductionSelenium supplementation has been suggested as a therapeutic option for Hashimoto's thyroiditis, but its effects on thyroid function and other patient‐related outcomes remain unclear.MethodsThis retrospective cohort study utilised a global federated health research network to compare patients with Hashimoto's thyroiditis who received selenium supplementation after diagnosis to those who did not. Propensity score matching was performed to balance baseline characteristics.

pmc-13506648.title: Understanding drivers of emergency department visits among patients from populations disproportionately affected by acute care use during cancer treatment: insights from qualitative interviews
pmc-13506648.creator: Jennifer Elston Lafata, Ethan Gibbons, Solomon Ayehu, Soroush Fariman, William A Wood, Jacob N Stein, Benyam Muluneh, Emily M Ray
pmc-13506648.description: PurposeEmergency department (ED) visits are frequent during cancer treatment, burdensome for patients and caregivers, and disproportionately affect those from marginalized groups. While many such events may be preventable, rates in practice remain stubbornly high, and patient perspectives on the drivers of ED use remain underexplored, particularly among marginalized patients.

uslaw-usc-t45-s1005.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t45-s1005.description: United States Code, Title 45 (Railroads); Chapter 19 (Rock Island Railroad Employee Assistance). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Authorization; time for agreement; use of funds The Secretary and the representatives of the various classes and crafts of employees of the Rock Island Railroad shall, not later than 90 days after January 14, 1983, enter into an agreement providing protection for employees.

uslaw-usc-t49-s13707.title: 49 U.S.C. § 13707 — Payment of rates
uslaw-usc-t49-s13707.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t49-s13707.description: United States Code, Title 49 (Transportation); Part B (Motor Carriers, Water Carriers, Brokers, And Freight Forwarders); Chapter 137 (Rates And Through Routes). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Transfer of Possession Upon Payment.— Except as provided in subsection (b), a carrier providing transportation or service subject to jurisdiction under this part shall give up possession at the destination of the property transported.
